scope: Two deliberately injected local failures executed with real validation, quality-gate, and MLflow SDK code; no external deployment state is inferred.

investigations.name: missing_dataset_feature
investigations.injected_change: One numeric feature in an isolated copy of Iris was replaced with an empty cell.

observed_exception.message: Dataset contains missing or non-finite values

diagnosis.root_cause: A required numeric feature is missing, so finite-value validation rejects the dataset.
diagnosis.resolution: Repair the source data, validate it, update its DVC pointer and commit provenance before retraining.
diagnosis.observed_containment: No prepared dataset, trained candidate, or approved serving artifact was created.

investigations.name: below_threshold_quality_gate
investigations.injected_change: F1=0.4 was deliberately recorded in a real isolated MLflow run; the configured gate is 0.85.

evidence.candidate_kind: unloaded sentinel bytes; injected metric is not a measured model result

diagnosis.root_cause: The deliberately supplied F1 score 0.4 is lower than the explicit acceptance threshold 0.85.
diagnosis.resolution: Inspect real evaluation and data evidence, then improve/retrain a candidate and rerun the gate. Revise policy only with an explicit justified decision.
diagnosis.observed_containment: The MLflow gate tag is failed and no serving model or approved metadata was published.
